title: Kyrie De beata virgine (de Orto)
desc: Marbrianus de Orto, Kyrie De beata virgine. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ort1007); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0.
